bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · MACD below zero, 100-day holds
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · MACD 跌破零轴，100 日均线守住

read.en: AMD slipped 0.6% on Oct 20 to $534.74, trading between $524.60 and $548.11. It is below the falling 5-day ($546.9) and 10-day ($580.9) averages and the rising 30-day ($581.2), but above the rising 100-day ($526.3) and 200-day ($397.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and has now dropped below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($598.92), and RSI is 39.8.
read.zh: AMD 10月20日下跌 0.6%，收于 $534.74，盘中区间 $524.60–548.11。股价位于下行的 5 日（$546.9）和 10 日均线（$580.9）及上行的 30 日均线（$581.2）下方，但仍在上行的 100 日（$526.3）和 200 日均线（$397.4）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，目前已跌破零轴；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$598.92），RSI 为 39.8。

read.en: The low dipped under the 100-day average, but the close held above it for a third session. Resistance is $547–548 (5-day average, Oct 20 high), then $567–571 (Oct 14 low and close) and $581 (10 and 30-day). Support is $524.6–526.3 (Oct 20 low, 100-day), then $495–498 and $480. A close below $524.6 would open $497; a close above $548 would target $570.
read.zh: 盘中低点一度跌破 100 日均线，但收盘连续第三个交易日守在其上方。阻力为 $547–548（5 日均线、10月20日高点），其次 $567–571（10月14日低点和收盘价）和 $581（10 日与 30 日均线）。支撑为 $524.6–526.3（10月20日低点、100 日均线），其次 $495–498 和 $480。若收盘跌破 $524.6，下一目标看 $497；若收盘站上 $548，下一目标看 $570。
